scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach(f=>{try{fs.rmSync(f)}catch{} }); const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')){ console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1);} "
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "pnpm --filter @workspace/portfolio run dev"
scripts.env:setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env'); console.log(fs.existsSync('.env') ? '.env ready' : 'failed');"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
